data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 深夜高层公寓阳台的红酒杯·「雪乃被你改变了呢……真让人不爽，又有点嫉妒」
data.description: 【高层公寓玻璃阳台·深夜】俯瞰千叶港夜景的独处时刻。阳乃穿着一袭高开衩黑色丝绒晚礼服，单手晃动着盛着勃艮第红酒的郁金香杯。夜风吹拂着她乌黑的发丝，城市的霓虹倒映在她眼底，平日里玩世不恭的假面裂开缝隙，流露出深沉的孤独与复杂情愫。
data.location: 豪华高层公寓观景阳台
data.action: 单手持红酒杯轻晃，黑丝绒开衩长裙被夜风轻拂，凤眸倒映霓虹怅惘
data.lighting: 万家灯火与港口冷蓝月光的城市夜景天光
data.camera: medium shot, balcony railing, wine glass, evening gown, city skyline
data.promptProse: Haruno Yukinoshita leans back against the glass railing of her high-rise penthouse balcony at midnight, overlooking the sprawling coastal city lights of Chiba. She wears an exquisite backless black velvet gown with a daring thigh slit that reveals her long legs in sheer dark stockings. Holding a crystal red wine glass loosely in one hand, her black hair whips in the sea breeze as her piercing dark eyes gaze wistfully into the distance, dropping her teasing mask for a moment of quiet melancholy.
